measurement: Dominant 26-connected component per original mask label; volume-weighted foreground mean minus per-plane local reference median, gap >3 and radius <=12 pixels; >=50 unmasked reference pixels; uint16 /65535.
fallback: For a label without a finite primary channel score, use the original nearest >=50 unmasked pixels beyond a 3-pixel gap, including distance ties, per occupied plane. Fail explicitly if unavailable.
threshold_transfer: Default cutoffs were calibrated on 241016/FoF5 only. Other fields use these fixed cutoffs without automatic refitting; cross-field transfer is not independently validated.
